info.title: Exampify API
info.description: Generated from the route registry in `src/lib/openapi/registry.ts`. docs/API_CONTRACTS.md is the human contract; this file is the machine one and is never edited by hand.

tags.name: internal
tags.description: Worker and cron endpoints; authenticated by signature or bearer token, never a session.

tags.name: practice
tags.description: Student practice and attempts. Session-authenticated and email-verified; every row is owned by the caller.

tags.name: studio
tags.description: Authoring studio. Session-authenticated; reads need `author`+, taxonomy writes need `admin`.

post.summary: Start a practice set or an assessment

201.description: The attempt and its snapshotted questions.

post.description: Any signed-in, email-verified student. The body names a scope — a curated `assessment`, a `topic`/`chapter`/`subject` with a selection rule, or the `assessment` linked to a `resource` — and the server chooses the questions; a client never sends a question id. Each item is snapshotted with its question version and points, so a later content edit cannot change what this attempt is scored against. A pool smaller than `questionCount` is a `201` with both counts, never an error; an empty pool is `422 NO_QUESTIONS_MATCH` with `appliedFilters`. An `Idempotency-Key` that already produced an attempt returns that attempt with `200` instead of creating a second one. The response never carries `answer_key`, an explanation or per-option feedback.

204.description: Accepted, dropped or rate-limited — always no content.

post.description: The only client analytics path. Accepts the client-safe event names only and answers `204` for anything the student must not see, including dropped or rate-limited events (§16.1).

get.description: Reports the database, the search cluster and index lag without exposing configuration. Used by the post-deploy smoke check and by R1 of the runbook.

post.description: Cron backstop (`BACKGROUND_JOBS.md` §8, J-01): re-publishes email rows left `pending` by a failed publish, and re-claims rows left `started` by a crash. Authenticated with `Authorization: Bearer $CRON_SECRET`, not a QStash signature.

QStash-signed. Claims one `job_runs` row and sends its rendered message. `200` means delivered or intentionally skipped; `500` means the attempt did not reach the relay and QStash should retry (`BACKGROUND_JOBS.md` §5.2).

get.description: Serves the committed `openapi.json` in non-production only (`OQ-API2` is unresolved, so a public contract is not assumed). Returns 404 in production.
`author`+. Filters `topicId`, `subjectId`, `mode`, `status` and `q` (title); `sort` is `updatedAt` (default) or `createdAt`; `limit` 1–50 with an opaque `cursor`.

post.description: `author`+. Scope is `topicId` (a topic's practice set) or `subjectId` alone (a course-wide test); every item must sit in that scope. `items` may be empty so the composer can start from the shell — the publish gate is what requires 1–60. `test`/`mock` need a 60–10 800 second duration; `practice` forbids one.

get.summary: Read an assessment with its items
get.description: `author`+. The ordered items, each with its full question (the studio may see `answerKey`). `no-store`.

patch.description: `author`+. `items` is replaced wholesale when sent, so order and `question_count` cannot drift. Requires `expectedUpdatedAt`; a mismatch is `409 CONTENT_CONFLICT`.

get.summary: Read the composer's live pool counts
get.description: `author`+. Question totals for the assessment's scope, split by status, type and difficulty; one grouped query, so the composer can show what is left to add.

post.summary: Duplicate an assessment as a draft
post.description: `author`+. A draft copy whose items reference the same questions (`§7.3`).

post.summary: Move an assessment through its lifecycle
post.description: `author`+ to submit, withdraw or archive; `reviewer`/`admin` to review, publish or unpublish; `admin` only for a direct publish from draft or a restore from the archive. The gates run on submit as well as on publish. A refusal is `422 PUBLISH_GATE_FAILED` with one `details` entry per failing field. A publish or unpublish writes its `search_events` row in the same transaction (ADR-021). Publishing needs 1–60 distinct questions that are all published and in scope, a stored count equal to the item list, and a 60–10 800 second duration for `test`/`mock` (`QUESTION_ENGINE.md` §10.2).
`author`+. Runs the `QUESTION_ENGINE.md` §10.2 gates and returns `{ passing, blocking[], warnings[] }` without writing.

get.description: `admin` reads every actor; `author`/`reviewer` only their own rows, and naming another actor is `403`. Newest first, cursor-paginated, filtered by `entityType`, `entityId`, `actorId` and an inclusive `from`/`to` range. `metadata` holds changed field names, transitions and ids — never a value, an answer key or an email address.

patch.description: `author`+. The whole payload is replaced and re-validated against the row's kind; there is no partial payload patch. Autosave sends `expectedUpdatedAt` every 4 s of idle time and a stale value is `409 CONTENT_CONFLICT`.

delete.description: `author`+. The remaining blocks keep contiguous positions.

get.description: `author`+. Filters on `subjectId`; ordered by `position`. The set is complete rather than paginated — a subject has a handful of chapters and the shell renders and reorders all of them. An unknown parameter is `422`.

post.description: `author`+. The slug is unique within its subject and is generated from the title when omitted. A new chapter starts as a draft; `status` moves through the transition endpoint.

post.summary: Move a chapter through its lifecycle
post.description: `author`+ to submit, withdraw or archive; `reviewer`/`admin` to review, publish or unpublish; `admin` only for a direct publish from draft or a restore from the archive. The gates run on submit as well as on publish. A refusal is `422 PUBLISH_GATE_FAILED` with one `details` entry per failing field. A publish or unpublish writes its `search_events` row in the same transaction (ADR-021). Publishing needs at least one published topic (`CONTENT_MODEL.md` §4.4).

get.summary: List the taxonomy tree, drafts included
get.description: Every curriculum with its levels nested. `author`+; this is the one read path that is meant to show drafts.

post.description: `admin` only. A slug is generated from the name when it is omitted; the new curriculum starts as a draft.
`admin` only. `orderedIds` must be every curriculum exactly once; a partial list is `422` rather than a lost position.

patch.description: `admin` only. Requires `expectedUpdatedAt`; a mismatch is `409 CONTENT_CONFLICT` and writes nothing.

delete.description: `admin` only. Sets `status = archived`; nothing is deleted. Refused with `409 HAS_PUBLISHED_CHILDREN` while a published level hangs off it.

post.summary: Create a level under a curriculum
post.description: `admin` only. The slug is unique within its curriculum.

post.summary: Move a curriculum through its lifecycle
post.description: `author`+ to submit, withdraw or archive; `reviewer`/`admin` to review, publish or unpublish; `admin` only for a direct publish from draft or a restore from the archive. The gates run on submit as well as on publish. A refusal is `422 PUBLISH_GATE_FAILED` with one `details` entry per failing field. A publish or unpublish writes its `search_events` row in the same transaction (ADR-021). `CONTENT_MODEL.md` §4.1 defines no curriculum gate; publishing a curriculum before its levels is legal.
`admin` only. `parentId` is the curriculum; `orderedIds` must be every one of its levels.

delete.description: `admin` only. Refused while a published subject hangs off it.

post.summary: Move a level through its lifecycle
post.description: `author`+ to submit, withdraw or archive; `reviewer`/`admin` to review, publish or unpublish; `admin` only for a direct publish from draft or a restore from the archive. The gates run on submit as well as on publish. A refusal is `422 PUBLISH_GATE_FAILED` with one `details` entry per failing field. A publish or unpublish writes its `search_events` row in the same transaction (ADR-021). No level gate: the subject gate is what keeps an empty course off the site.

get.description: `author`+. Newest first, cursor-paginated. Deleted rows are excluded unless `status=deleted`. `q` searches alt text, the only human-readable field on a row.

201.description: The upload URL and its media id.

post.description: `author`+. Creates a `pending` row and a `PUT` signed for the exact content type and length, valid for 5 minutes. The purpose fixes the MIME allow-list and the size cap (`CONTENT_MODEL.md` §4.9): an image is at most 8 MB, a document 25 MB.

patch.description: `author`+. `altText` is the only editable field; the bytes, type and storage key are fixed at confirm. An image needs non-empty alt text before the resource that embeds it can publish.

delete.description: `author`+. Soft delete; the blob is purged later. Refused with `409 MEDIA_IN_USE` while a resource block, subject hero or question still references it.

post.description: `author`+. No body. `HEAD`s the object, compares the size, checks the magic bytes and scrubs an SVG before the row becomes `ready`. Idempotent: a second call returns the same row.

get.summary: Sign a read for a private asset
get.description: `author`+. A presigned `GET` valid for at most 10 minutes; never a long-lived URL.

`author`+. A total per content table, the content-gap report (live topics with no learning resource and live topics with no assessment) and the latest audit entries. A gap is informational, not a defect: a topic may publish with either a resource or an assessment. Recent edits follow the audit rule — `admin` sees every actor, `author`/`reviewer` only their own (`SEC §6`).

`author`+. Filters `topicId`, `subjectId`, `type`, `difficulty`, `status`, `q` (stem) and `authorId`; `sort` is `updatedAt` (default) or `createdAt`, with `dir`; `limit` 1–50 and an opaque `cursor`. The list projection never selects `answerKey` or the explanation.

201.description: Created, with its options and key.

post.description: `author`+. `topicId` is the primary topic; `secondaryTopicIds` cross-list it (`ADR-003`). A draft may start without options or a key — the editor fills them — but a sent key is checked against the options it names. A new question starts as a draft; `status` moves through the transition endpoint.
`author`+. Runs the `QUESTION_ENGINE.md` §10.1 gates on an existing question and returns `{ passing, blocking[], warnings[] }` without writing. The same evaluation runs on the publish transition.

get.summary: Read a question with its key
get.description: `author`+. The one question response that carries `answerKey`, the options' feedback and the cross-listings. `no-store`; never reachable by a student.

patch.description: `author`+. Partial; `options` and `answerKey` are replaced whole when sent, and changing `type` requires a matching key in the same save. Requires `expectedUpdatedAt`; a mismatch is `409 CONTENT_CONFLICT`.

delete.description: `author`+. Archive only; nothing is deleted. Refused with `409 QUESTION_IN_USE` while a published assessment still lists the question.

post.summary: Duplicate a question as a draft
post.description: `author`+. Copies the stem, options, key and cross-listings; the copy starts as a draft with version 1.

post.summary: Move a question through its lifecycle
post.description: `author`+ to submit, withdraw or archive; `reviewer`/`admin` to review, publish or unpublish; `admin` only for a direct publish from draft or a restore from the archive. The gates run on submit as well as on publish. A refusal is `422 PUBLISH_GATE_FAILED` with one `details` entry per failing field. A publish or unpublish writes its `search_events` row in the same transaction (ADR-021). Publishing needs a 10–4000 character stem, 60+ characters of explanation, 1–10 points, an answer key that matches the type, 2–8 options for choice types, at least two correct options for a multiple select, a published-or-in-review primary topic and ready media with alt text (`QUESTION_ENGINE.md` §10.1).

get.summary: Read a resource with its blocks

200.description: The resource and its ordered blocks.

get.description: `author`+. Blocks are returned as validated payloads, not HTML.

patch.description: `author`+. Requires `expectedUpdatedAt`; a mismatch is `409 CONTENT_CONFLICT` carrying `currentUpdatedAt` (§12).

post.summary: Link an assessment to a resource
post.description: `author`+. The assessment must be in this resource's topic (or a subject-level assessment for its subject), otherwise `422 ASSESSMENT_SCOPE_MISMATCH` (API-20). Linking sets `format` to `lesson_with_practice`.

delete.description: `author`+. Unlinking the last assessment reverts `format` to `study_material`.

post.description: `author`+. The payload is validated against its `kind` by the shared block union; a mismatch is `422 INVALID_BLOCK` with the offending path (API-19). Positions are renumbered contiguously.
`author`+. A whole-list operation: `orderedIds` must contain every block exactly once (`CONTENT_MODEL.md` §5.2).
`author`+. Runs the same block and publish gates the transition endpoint runs, returning `{ passing, blocking[], warnings[] }` without writing a status.

post.summary: Duplicate a resource as a draft
post.description: `author`+. Deep copy: fresh block ids, `-copy` slug, `draft` status, the same assessment links (`CONTENT_MODEL.md` §7).

get.description: `author`+. Returns the rendered block payloads and resolved media for a staff preview; the preview page sends `noindex`.

post.summary: Move a learning resource through its lifecycle
post.description: `author`+ to submit, withdraw or archive; `reviewer`/`admin` to review, publish or unpublish; `admin` only for a direct publish from draft or a restore from the archive. The gates run on submit as well as on publish. A refusal is `422 PUBLISH_GATE_FAILED` with one `details` entry per failing field. A publish or unpublish writes its `search_events` row in the same transaction (ADR-021). Publishing needs 200 characters of prose, a valid first block, ready media with alt text, parsing TeX, published in-scope assessments and related material, unique heading anchors and a payload under 256 kB (`CONTENT_MODEL.md` §4.6).

get.description: `author`+. Filters `levelId`, `status`, `q`; `sort` is `position` (default), `name` or `updatedAt`, with `dir`; `limit` 1–50 and an opaque `cursor` (§10). An unknown parameter is `422`.

post.description: `admin` only. The slug is unique within its level.
`admin` only. `parentId` is the education level; `orderedIds` must be every one of its subjects.

patch.description: `admin` only. Requires `expectedUpdatedAt`. Publishing sets `published_at` if it was null.

delete.description: `admin` only. Refused while a published chapter hangs off it.

post.summary: Move a subject through its lifecycle
post.description: `author`+ to submit, withdraw or archive; `reviewer`/`admin` to review, publish or unpublish; `admin` only for a direct publish from draft or a restore from the archive. The gates run on submit as well as on publish. A refusal is `422 PUBLISH_GATE_FAILED` with one `details` entry per failing field. A publish or unpublish writes its `search_events` row in the same transaction (ADR-021). Publishing needs at least one published chapter (`CONTENT_MODEL.md` §4.3).

get.description: `author`+. Filters `chapterId`, `status` and a title search `q`; ordered by `position`. Complete rather than paginated, for the same reason as chapters. An unknown parameter is `422`.

post.description: `author`+. 1–12 learning objectives of 8–160 characters each. The slug is unique within its chapter; a new topic starts as a draft.

patch.description: `author`+. Requires `expectedUpdatedAt`. `learningObjectives` is replaced wholesale when sent.

get.summary: List a topic's resources, drafts included
get.description: `author`+. Ordered by `position`. `format` is derived: any linked assessment makes it `lesson_with_practice`, otherwise `study_material`.

post.description: `author`+. The slug is unique within the topic and generated from the title when omitted. A new resource starts as a draft; `status` moves through the transition endpoint.

post.summary: Move a topic through its lifecycle
post.description: `author`+ to submit, withdraw or archive; `reviewer`/`admin` to review, publish or unpublish; `admin` only for a direct publish from draft or a restore from the archive. The gates run on submit as well as on publish. A refusal is `422 PUBLISH_GATE_FAILED` with one `details` entry per failing field. A publish or unpublish writes its `search_events` row in the same transaction (ADR-021). Publishing needs a 40–320 character summary and at least one published learning resource or assessment (`CONTENT_MODEL.md` §4.5).

400.description: Malformed JSON or an unparseable request.

401.description: Missing or invalid credentials (session, QStash signature or cron bearer).

403.description: The actor lacks the capability, or the request is cross-origin.

404.description: Unknown id or slug, or not visible to this actor.

409.description: A conflict: the record changed under you, the slug is taken, or published children block an archive.

422.description: Validation failed; `details` lists one entry per offending field.

500.description: Unhandled failure; the message is generic.
